# dirname

Print the parent component of each path through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/dirname /home/user/report.txt

moonx cli/dirname one/file.txt two/file.txt
```

Print one result per operand. A name without a directory component produces a dot.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-z`, `--zero` | End each result with NUL. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Paths are handled lexically, without resolving symbolic links or checking existence.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
